  "rationale": "Two rounds of two overlapping copies through slots 0/1. Round 1: read src2->slot0 and src0->slot1 concurrently, one blocking wait_reads guarantees both values initialized under any DMA completion order before publish/acquire; writes go to dst0 (origin 2) and dst1 (origin 0), matching expected[0]=2, expected[1]=0. One wait_writes drains both pending writes so releases are valid regardless of completion order. Round 2 repeats with src3->dst2 and src1->dst3, matching expected[2]=3, expected[3]=1. Every non-wait op is enabled in all reachable interleavings: reads target distinct slots, writes target distinct destinations from acquired+initialized slots, and slots are reused only after wait_writes+release. Minimality: each of the 4 page copies strictly needs reserve/read/publish/acquire/write/release (6 ops each = 24); two read batches force 2 wait_reads (publish needs initialized value, only observable via blocking wait), and writes preceding every release force 2 wait_writes; 1-slot alternative would need 8 waits, so 4 waits / 28 commands / peak 2 live slots is lexicographically optimal."
